papers.exact_title: LONG TIME DERIVATION OF THE BOLTZMANN EQUATION FROM HARD SPHERE DYNAMICS
claims: The authors rigorously derive Boltzmann’s kinetic equation from hard-sphere dynamics for arbitrarily long times, as long as the Boltzmann solution exists.
They state that, together with a companion paper connecting this result to hydrodynamic limits, the work completes Hilbert’s Sixth Problem for a rarefied hard-sphere gas.

papers.exact_title: Self-Supervised Learning with Lie Symmetries for Partial Differential Equations
claims: The authors learn general-purpose PDE representations from heterogeneous data using joint-embedding self-supervised learning.
Their representation outperforms baselines on invariant tasks such as PDE-coefficient regression and also improves neural-solver time-stepping performance.
